To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we propose a hierarchical control approach for multi-tasking robotic applications that preserves passivity and that we show the passivity of the proposed approach via two different energy tanks, one local and one global.
we propose two passive hierarchical impedance controllers for robotic systems with multiple tasks.
we propose two novel hierarchical impedance controllers for robotic manipulators, which are passive and can be used in safety-critical applications.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of a hierarchical control architecture that can handle multiple objectives with different priorities while guaranteeing passivity.
the design and analysis of a novel hierarchical control approach, which is able to realize several tasks with a given priority order in a passively stable way.
the development of a novel approach for the realization of a passive hierarchical control architecture.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed approach is the first one that enables a passivity-preserving hierarchical control.
the global approach has better properties than the local approach.
the global energy tank approach is superior to the local approach in terms of performance, but the local approach is superior in terms of robustness against disturbances and parameter variations.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed approach can be utilized to realize a hierarchy of tasks with passivity, while null space projection cannot.
the proposed hierarchical controllers are able to realize the strict order of priority while maintaining the passivity.
the presented methods are able to maintain passivity in the presence of hierarchical control objectives.
The main takeaway from our work is that
passivity can be preserved in a hierarchical control system.
passivity is not a property of the controller, but of the closed loop system.
it is possible to realize strict hierarchies without sacrificing passivity.
